task_completion.description: Create five tiddlers tagged 'Person' for Queen Victoria, Prince Albert, Victoria Princess Royal, Edward VII, and Princess Alice.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Recent' tab or a list of tiddlers containing all five names, each with the 'Person' tag applied.

task_completion.description: Assign birth-date, mother, and father fields to the relevant tiddlers as specified.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Fields' section at the bottom of the tiddler edit or view mode showing keys like 'birth-date', 'mother', and 'father' with their respective values.

task_completion.description: Create a new tiddler tagged '$:/tags/ViewTemplate' to act as the dynamic display logic.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler open in the editor showing the tag '$:/tags/ViewTemplate' and wikitext code involving filters or transclusions.

task_completion.description: Ensure the ViewTemplate uses a filter to only display on tiddlers tagged 'Person'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The wikitext in the ViewTemplate tiddler containing a list widget or conditional (e.g., <$list filter="[all[current]tag[Person]]">).

task_completion.description: The ViewTemplate displays clickable links to the mother and father tiddlers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the view mode of a child tiddler (e.g., Edward VII), the names of the parents appear as blue internal links.

task_completion.description: The ViewTemplate displays a list of children by querying which tiddlers list the current person as a parent, without hardcoding names.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the view mode of 'Queen Victoria', a list of her three children is visible. The code for this must show a filter like '[mother<currentTiddler>]' or '[father<currentTiddler>]' rather than a static list of names.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface to create and edit tiddlers rather than just modifying the underlying file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the 'plus' button, the tag dropdown, and the 'save' tick icon in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the names of children into the parent tiddlers' body text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'text' field of the 'Queen Victoria' and 'Prince Albert' tiddlers should be empty or contain general info, not a manual list of their children.

integrity.description: The genealogy information is rendered via the ViewTemplate, not just written into the tiddler body.
integrity.visual_evidence: When viewing a 'Person' tiddler, the genealogy info appears, but when the same tiddler is put into 'Edit' mode, that info is absent from the main text area.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The five required persons are: Queen Victoria (1819-05-24), Prince Albert (1819-08-26), Victoria, Princess Royal (1840-11-21), Edward VII (1841-11-09), and Princess Alice (1843-04-25). The children must list Queen Victoria as 'mother' and Prince Albert as 'father' in their fields. The ViewTemplate must be tagged '$:/tags/ViewTemplate' to be active.
